 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R In the first category of cases, heard the arguments of Mr. Subramanium Prasad, Mr. V. Shekhar and Mr. Pinaki Mishra, learned senior counsel for the respective parties.
They have concluded their submissions.

In the second category of cases under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Regulations framed thereunder, challenging prohibitory orders in the transferred cases, heard the arguments of Mr. Sudhir Chandra, learned senior counsel, in part.
At this stage, he has pointed out that arguments in T.C.(C) No. 95/2012 have not been heard, however, the same has been mentioned in the previous order dated 1.09.2016, which needs to be deleted.
Ordered accordingly.
We have directed learned counsel appearing for all the parties to prepare brief points which they are going to address in their respective cases.
The same are permitted to be filed before the next date of listing and they are also permitted to file their written submissions simultaneously.
List for further hearing on 15.09.2016 as part heard matters.
